title: JSON 3GPP: correction of decoding SupportFeatures
description:
The value is in HEX ASCII string format and needs to be converted
first for bitmask list to show correct flags

notes.body: Hints on how this can be made dynamic and match length of offset_reverse ?

You could replace this line and the `tvb_memcpy()` line with

`guint8 *hex_ascii = tvb_memdup(pinfo->pool, tvb, offset, len);`

for a dynamically allocated array with the appropriate length, scoped to the lifetime of the packet.

Before change ex "B" got value "0010" but after change it will get value "1011", this to conform with table 5.2.2-3

We should probably validate that the value is on the [0;f] range otherwise with a malformed packet we are gonna call proto_tree_add_bitmask_list_value with a value -1 (I do not have access so the source code and thus I cannot check what will happen then).
